title: Does Gender Matter? Towards Fairness in Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Creating parallel conversational contexts by substituting male and female word pairs, and evaluating the dialogue model's responses using diversity metrics, offensive language detection (politeness), sentiment analysis, and the occurrence frequency of career versus family attribute words.

Creating parallel conversational contexts by substituting Standard US English words with African American English words, and evaluating the dialogue model's responses using diversity metrics, offensive language detection (politeness), sentiment analysis, and the occurrence frequency of pleasant versus unpleasant attribute words.
